name: Algebraic Constraint Masking
description: Replaced the explicit exact-cover requirement ("collectively utilize all k") with an algebraic condition on the number of distinct elements in the chosen subset ($d_1 \times d_2 \times d_3 = k^3$). Since the elements are drawn from a universe of size $k$, this product can only equal $k^3$ if all $k$ elements in each category are used. Models that fail to deduce this equivalence will be unable to formulate an efficient pruning strategy (such as DLX or grouping by one category) and will time out on the naive search space.
